naming: <zone>_<E km>_<N km> of the tile's south-west corner
dem: dem/<tile>.tif float32 1 m NAVD88 m, nodata -9999
dsm: dsm/<tile>.tif float32 1 m NAVD88 m, nodata -9999 (land tiles only)
cover: cover/<tile>.tif uint8 0.5 m, nodata 255 (land tiles only)
ortho: ortho/<tile>.tif RGB uint8 0.6 m native NAIP grid (land tiles only)
